title: Generic hypersurface model with a compatible fraction field
statement:
Let X and S be affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with S integral
[def-pc-integral-scheme], and let f:X\to S be locally finitely presented
[def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let \eta be a generic point of S. Suppose
X_\eta [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced
[def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Put A=\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S). There exist n and P over the base sections A [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] for which H=Spec(A[t_1,...,t_n]/(P)), with its coefficient-induced structure map g, has geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced generic fibre. Both generic fibres are integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], g_eta is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and there exists an isomorphism from Frac(Gamma(X_eta,O)) to Frac(Gamma(H_eta,O)) commuting with the two maps from Gamma(Spec kappa(eta),O) induced by the generic structure maps. No common opens or birationality are asserted.

proof.text: Apply the field hypersurface theorem to the affine finite-type generic fibre over kappa(eta). Obtain n, Q, geometric irreducibility and reducedness, and a fraction-ring equivalence fixing global sections of Spec kappa(eta).
Apply polynomial hypersurface descent to Q. Obtain a polynomial P over the base sections and an isomorphism from its generic fibre to the Q-hypersurface, commuting with both structure maps.

Prove integrality over the field from geometric irreducibility and reducedness using Mathlib. Prove local finite type of the Q-hypersurface via the finite-type polynomial quotient. Transport these properties and the geometric properties across the generic-fibre isomorphism. Its contravariant global-section ring equivalence extends to fraction rings by IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv. Compose with the field-model equivalence. Naturality of appTop and the descent commutation show the composite fixes the residue-field sections.

proof_origin.note: S2 reduction: the field-only construction remains a named hole; coefficient descent, integrality, finite type, isomorphism transport and fraction-ring compatibility glue are proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_generic_fibre_hypersurface_function_field_model
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine S] [IsIntegral S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (η : S) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (hgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η))
    (hred : GeometricallyReduced (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(S, ⊤)),
      let H := Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(S, ⊤) ⧸ Ideal.span {P}))
      let g : H ⟶ S := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {P})).comp MvPolynomial.C)) ≫ S.isoSpec.inv
      GeometricallyIrreducible (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η) ∧
        GeometricallyReduced (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η) ∧
        IsIntegral (f.fiber η) ∧ IsIntegral (g.fiber η) ∧
        LocallyOfFiniteType (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η) ∧
        ∃ e : FractionRing Γ(f.fiber η, ⊤) ≃+* FractionRing Γ(g.fiber η, ⊤),
          ∀ a : Γ(Spec (.of (S.residueField η)), ⊤),
            e (algebraMap Γ(f.fiber η, ⊤) (FractionRing Γ(f.fiber η, ⊤))
              ((f.fiberToSpecResidueField η).appTop.hom a)) =
            algebraMap Γ(g.fiber η, ⊤) (FractionRing Γ(g.fiber η, ⊤))
              ((g.fiberToSpecResidueField η).appTop.hom a)
